Harkesh Manuja, J. (Oral)
1.

By way of present present petition filed under Sections 10 & 12 of the Contempt of Courts Act,
1971 read with Article 215 of the Constitution of India, India contempt proceedings are sought to be initiated against the respondents on account of non-compliance compliance of order dated 08.01.2018 18 passed by this Court in CWP No.29947 of 2017, 2017, whereby the respondents were directed to consider the claim of petitioner regarding release of his land and/or to acquire the same in accordance with law.

2. In pursuance of last order dated 10.04.2024 10.04.2024,, additional affidavit of Sh.
Sh Kaushal Gutam, Defence Estate Officer, Pathankot Circle, Pathankot has been filed in Court,
which is taken on record.

As per affidavit, Notification dated 26.07.2024 in exercise of powers under Pardeep Singh Pathania vs Sanjay Mitra And Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124681213/

3. In view of above, learned learned counsel for the petitioner submits that at this stage, no cause survives in the present petition.
4. Accordingly, the present petition is disposed of, however, the Accordingly, petitioner shall be at liberty to seek revival of the present contempt petition in case, case any cause survives.
